title: Take staging and production dark until authentication lands
description:
**Phase 1 of 7.**

- **Blocked by:** nothing, start today
- **Runs in parallel with:** 79ca6a, 0ab02c, 272aea, 1ebc7d
- **Unblocks:** bc830a in phase 7, which brings staging back

---
hey.chattic.us and staging.chattic.us answer unauthenticated requests from the open internet today; ChatticusThinTurnProduction returns environment production on /api/health. Neither environment needs to serve anyone before this initiative ships, so neither should be reachable. Development stays up because the work happens there.

We are not adding a temporary gate. The correct move is to stop serving what is not ready, and to rely on the spend controls in 79ca6a for development.

**Done when:** the staging and production web stacks no longer serve and the decision is recorded here.
